facts: Muccio reported martial law still in effect a week after constitutional amendment.
Muccio reported seven assemblymen conditionally released and three unconditionally released, but individual identities and legal orders not verified.
Muccio described legislative proposal on officeholder resignation before candidacy and opposition political reorganization.
events.uncertainty: Diplomatic assessment, not official Korean enactment or definitive motive finding.

facts: Harrison favored conditional acceptance of Alternative B only with safeguards against coercion.
He proposed screening at Panmunjom and full exchange of approximately 12,000 UNC for 83,000 POWs before rescreening.
